## Monitor counts, minima and retry flags (`RegisterMonitor::count`) {#sec-ch10-counts}

<!-- PROVENANCE

### Summary

Beside the amounts, the monitor keeps three small vectors: integer counters of events, minima, and retry flags.
A poster hands it a whole mask of faces or cells; the monitor does not reduce each mask at once. It copies the stage's
masks into one buffer and reduces them all at the stage's end with one integer cumulative sum, so there are no
atomics and the reduction is the same eager and captured.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Count events per step without a reduction per mask, @eq-ch10-counts; keep the step's minima and an OR of the retry causes.

**Data.** In: masks or 0-d counts, values for a minimum, a flag or mask per cause. Out: `counters` (int64), `minima` (FP64, $+\infty$ when unset), `retry_flags` (int32 0/1).

**Placement.** Masks during the stage; `flush_counts` at `end_stage`, in the combine.

**Activation.** Always; a name must be declared in the register's request.

**Guarantee / limits.** Integer sums, exact; a declared name with no poster stays zero.

**Evidence.** `test_flux_register.<b>`, `test_fp32_face_floor_counts_python` (Tests).
:::

Local symbols: $c$ is a counter, $j$ a slot of the stage's count buffer, $[b_j, e_j)$ the slot's range in the buffer
and $C$[^rg-3b633fdb66aa] the buffer's inclusive cumulative sum behind one leading zero.

### Derivation

None beyond a prefix sum. If the stage's masks lie one after the other in a buffer whose first element is zero, and
$C$ is its cumulative sum, the number of set entries in slot $j$ is $C_{e_j} - C_{b_j}$. Counter $c$ receives

$$
n_c \mathrel{+}= \sum_{j\,:\,\mathrm{counter}(j)=c} \bigl(C_{e_j} - C_{b_j}\bigr),
$$ {#eq-ch10-counts}

exact because every addition is an integer one.

### Numerical method

**Declared names.** The hydro register declares its names in `HydroImpl::reset`
({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}}): fifteen counters (seven `ef.*` names, `face_floor.rho`,
`face_floor.p`, `face_floor.species`, `riemann.pstar_clamp`, `riemann.llf`, `thermo.temp_solve`,
`thermo.pres_solve` and `implicit.fp64_columns`, last so the others keep their indices), one minimum, `ef.pos_min`,
and five retry causes (`ef.floor_patch`, `ef.nan`, `ef.vapor_fail`, `ef.heat_capacity`, `implicit.column`). A name
that was not declared throws ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::counter_index >}}).

**Who posts at the pin.** The sweep posts one mask per face floor that ran and one per Riemann event
({{< code src/hydro/sweep.cpp post_face_floors >}}, {{< code src/hydro/sweep.cpp post_riemann_events >}}). Two
places count face floors directly: the FP32 split path of the sweep counts the faces it floors itself, which is
what `test_fp32_face_floor_counts_python` reads ({{< code src/hydro/sweep.cpp reconstruct_faces >}}), and the
well-balanced $x_1$ reconstruction counts its fallbacks as floors
({{< code src/recon/well_balanced_x1.cpp WellBalancedX1::forward >}}). The
saturation adjustment posts kintera's rows 1 and 2, the temperature and pressure solves that did not converge
({{< code src/mesh/meshblock_advance.cpp MeshBlockImpl::stage_saturation >}}). The implicit correction counts the
columns it retried in FP64 and flags `implicit.column` with the column status
({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::_apply_implicit_correction >}}). No code at the pin posts the seven `ef.*`
counters or `ef.pos_min`; the request's comment says nothing writes them yet
({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}}). The meters of those names live in the block's `EfStatus`
(@sec-ch08-efstatus).

**`count`.** A 0-d count adds into its counter at once, one launch; a float count is cast to the counters' integer
dtype first ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::count >}}). A mask or vector is flattened and
copied into the next slot of the stage's count buffer. The slot pattern, counter index and length per slot, is
checked at each post; a new or changed slot lays the buffer and the segment ends out again, eagerly
({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::pend_slot_ >}}).

**`flush_counts`** forms @eq-ch10-counts: one integer cumulative sum over the buffer, one gather of the segment ends
and starts, zero-padded to the largest number of slots per counter (a pad points at the leading zero), one sum over
the slots, one add into the counters, then one zero of the buffer
({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::flush_counts >}}). The comment there records why: an
`index_add_` would scatter-add every mask element with FP64 atomics on CUDA. `end_stage` calls it, inside the captured
combine ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::end_stage >}}), and the buffer is registered with
the state store as `freg.counts`, and the scalar register's as `sreg.counts`, so a warm-up's flush does not leave the
capture an empty buffer ({{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::register_flux_storage >}}).

**Minima and flags.** `record_min` keeps the minimum of the slot and the posted value's minimum
({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::record_min >}}). `flag_retry` ORs a flag, or the `any` of a
mask, into the cause's slot in place ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::flag_retry >}}).

| what | code link | symbol | switch |

| declared names | {{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}} | `req.counters`, `req.minima`, `req.retry` | |
| a count | {{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor::count >}} | `_pend_buf` | |

|---|---|---|---|
| `test_flux_register.<b>` (`census_counts_minima_and_retry_flags`) | a mask of $\{3, 4\}$ and a 0-d 2 count 9 after the flush; the minimum of 0.5, 0.25 and 0.75 is 0.25; a retry OR stays set; an undeclared name throws; a rollback clears all three | exact | ({{< code tests/test_flux_register.cpp RegisterMonitor.census_counts_minima_and_retry_flags >}}) |
| `test_fp32_face_floor_counts_python` | on the FP32 split path, a stage with the pressure floor raised to $5\times10^4$ Pa counts `face_floor.p` > 0; at the deck's floor it counts 0 | pass/fail | the test's own checks ({{< code tests/test_fp32_face_floor_counts.py counts >}}) |
| `test_flux_register.<b>` (`a_failed_column_flags_implicit_column`) | a column whose state holds a NaN sets the `implicit.column` flag, and a clean one does not | exact | ({{< code tests/test_flux_register.cpp FluxRegister.a_failed_column_flags_implicit_column >}}) |

All pass at the pin, on CPU (@tbl-ch10-ctest-run). Run on its own at the pin, the FP32 test prints 0 pressure floors
at the deck's floor and 4340 at $5\times10^4$ Pa, and 5692 for the FP64 block at $5\times10^4$ Pa.[^ch10-ffc]

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
- Seven counters and the one minimum the request declares, the `ef.*` names, have no poster at the pin and read
  zero and $+\infty$. Their meters are kept in `EfStatus` (@sec-ch08-efstatus), which is what the cycle line and
  `test_cycle_diagnostics` read.
:::

1. **The outline's second test reads other meters.** STRUCTURE.md 10.5 names `test_cycle_diagnostics`; its cases
   check the cycle line's positivity and clamp meters, which come from `EfStatus`, not from the register's
   counters ({{< code tests/test_cycle_diagnostics.cpp cycle_info.positivity_meters_read_their_hand_computed_values >}}).
   This section does not use it as evidence.
